summary: Four days after the October 7 attacks, Drazan posted on X that she stands with Israel in the ongoing war, tagging #IStandWithIsrael. Her 2026 Oregon gubernatorial platform addresses domestic issues—regulation, housing, homelessness, criminal justice—without any statement on Gaza or Palestinian rights. The single recorded position on this conflict is an early, unqualified expression of solidarity with Israel.
